Marketing

01

Build Your Store on Meta, from zero to scale.

Julia launched BYS on Meta ads this quarter and scaled it fast, while beating the cost goal per paid trial. It has already crossed one million dollars in ad revenue from Meta.

Led by Julia
02

The niche selector test: +15% paid trials.

Visitors on the BYS homepage now pick a niche and see a store being built for it. Free trials went from 53.4% to 58.3%. End-to-end, paid trials rose about 15%.

Led by Yarden
03

Site speed: 10% → 94%.

The share of AutoDS desktop pages passing Google's speed test went from about 10% to 94%. Slow pages were holding back our search ranking, and 94% of website trials start on the homepage and landing pages.

Led by Alae

CX

CX started bringing revenue in this quarter, while our AI took on more of the work.

01

$26.1K in revenue from CX, 2.6x the goal.

Three new CX plays brought in about $26K of incremental lifetime value this quarter, against a $10K goal. The biggest one is our AI widget: it reaches customers right after a failed payment or a broken store connection. In a real A/B test, 42.6% of them stayed, vs 17.9% without it.

41% → 49%

Orin solves more on its own.

Our AI support agent went from resolving 41% of conversations in Q2 to 49% by the end of September. Customer satisfaction with Orin: 89%, above the 80% target.

4.3 → 4.5

Our ratings went up.

AutoDS on the Shopify app store: 4.3 → 4.5. ZipStore: 3.4 → 3.9. And we recovered 42% of negative reviews, against a 30% goal.

96%

Every conversation is now quality-checked.

AI scores every support conversation, not a sample, with 96% accuracy.

📊

Data

01

We launched AutoDS Brain.

Our shared AI analyst. Ask a data question in plain language and get the answer in minutes, instead of waiting in the analyst queue. It knows 36 of our KPIs and connects to 13 tools. 8 people use it today, and it rolls out to the whole company by March 2027.

02

Brain already caught real problems.

It found 325,597 fake bot accounts across BYS and AutoDS. And when our Impact data broke in September, it recovered 3,742 free trials and 533 paid trials we would have lost track of.

👋

After 7 years, Ofir is moving on

When he joined, I told him: "I have no time and nothing to give you. Come fix my SEO."

The guy who came to fix our SEO built our marketing from zero and became our CMO.

A lot of what you read above started with him. And he's not going far: Ofir stays with us as an external advisor.

His move is also an opportunity. As we shared, we're opening his position to new managers and promoting from within. We love seeing people grow inside the company.

Ofir, thank you for everything. ❤️
